title: popv
description: Performs popular major vote cell typing on single cell sequence data using multiple algorithms. Note that this is a one-shot version of PopV.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Arguments related to the input (aka query) dataset.

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `input.h5mu`

input_layer.description: Which layer to use. If no value is provided, the counts are assumed to be in the `.X` slot. Otherwise, count data is expected to be in `.layers[input_layer]`.

input_obs_batch.description: Key in obs field of input adata for batch information. If no value is provided, batch label is assumed to be unknown.

input_var_subset.description: Subset the input object with this column.

input_obs_label.description: Key in obs field of input adata for label information. This is only used for training scANVI. Unlabelled cells should be set to `"unknown_celltype_label"`.

unknown_celltype_label.description: If `input_obs_label` is specified, cells with this value will be treated as unknown and will be predicted by the model.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Arguments related to the reference dataset.
User-provided reference tissue. The data that will be used as reference to call cell types.
reference.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `TS_Bladder_filtered.h5ad`

reference_layer.description: Which layer to use. If no value is provided, the counts are assumed to be in the `.X` slot. Otherwise, count data is expected to be in `.layers[reference_layer]`.

reference_obs_label.description: Key in obs field of reference AnnData with cell-type information.

reference_obs_batch.description: Key in obs field of input adata for batch information.

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `output.h5mu`

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

methods.description: Methods to call cell types. By default, runs KNN_SCVI and SCANVI_POPV.
methods.help_text: type: `array`, multiple: True, required, example: `KNN_SCVI;SCANVI_POPV`, choices: `CELLTYPIST`|`KNN_BBKNN`|`KNN_HARMONY`|`KNN_SCANORAMA`|`KNN_SCVI`|`ONCLASS`|`Random_Forest`|`SCANVI_POPV`|`Support_Vector`

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
